nodes.name: Booking Status Webhook
nodes.notes: POST /booking-status. Receives booking confirmations from the booking provider. Header X-Lead-Engine-Secret must match $vars.LEAD_ENGINE_SECRET. Responds only after a Respond To Webhook node runs.

nodes.name: Valid Ingress Secret?
nodes.notes: Security gate BEFORE any Google Sheets lookup or business logic (live-validated V4.3 pattern: headers live at $json.headers on webhook v2 output; secret lives in n8n Variables).

nodes.name: Booking Reference Present?
nodes.notes: Requires a lead_id OR booking_id in the request body (webhook v2 nests payload under body).

nodes.name: Read Existing Leads
nodes.notes: Reads ALL leads rows; resolution + tenant scoping happens in the Code node.

nodes.name: Read Existing Bookings
nodes.notes: Reads existing bookings so repeated booking_id events can be detected for idempotency (TEST 2). If your n8n version has no name mode on this field, reselect the bookings tab from the dropdown once.

nodes.name: Get Business Config
nodes.notes: Sequential read chain (live-validated topology): each read is guaranteed to execute before the resolve node references it via $('Node Name').

nodes.name: Resolve Lead & Booking
nodes.notes: Resolves the lead strictly within business_id (no cross-business resolution), detects replayed booking_ids, builds the booking record, and emits HTML-escaped copies for the owner email. Reads all prior nodes explicitly by name.

nodes.name: Respond 404 Lead Not Found
nodes.notes: No booking append and no lead update happen on this path.

nodes.name: Booking Already Recorded?
nodes.notes: Idempotency gate: repeated booking-status events for the same booking_id never append a second bookings row nor touch the lead again.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'booked', duplicate: true, lead_id: $('Resolve Lead & Booking').first().json.booking.lead_id, booking_id: $('Resolve Lead & Booking').first().json.booking.booking_id, code: 200 }) }}

nodes.name: Respond 200 Idempotent Replay
nodes.notes: Safe idempotent response for duplicate booking events; state was already committed on the first event.

nodes.name: Prep Booking Row
nodes.notes: Flattens the booking record into the exact bookings tab column set.

nodes.name: Append Booking
nodes.notes: Explicit field mapping to the exact bookings headers (live-proven append shape from Lead Intake V4.3).

nodes.name: Prep Lead Booked Update
nodes.notes: Marks the matched lead booked (booked=TRUE, booked_at=booking.booking_at, booking_id, status=booked, next_followup_at cleared, updated_at refreshed) and carries email context. Reads authoritative data via $('Resolve Lead & Booking'), not Sheets output shape.

parameters.valueToMatchOn: ={{ ($('Booking Status Webhook').first().json.body || $('Booking Status Webhook').first().json).lead_id || $('Prep Lead Booked Update').first().json.lead_id }}

nodes.name: Update Lead Booked
nodes.notes: Updates the EXISTING lead row matched by Column to Match On = lead_id (never row_number, never creates a second row). Match value prefers the stable webhook lead_id per the live-validated pattern.

nodes.name: Owner Email Present?
nodes.notes: Owner email is attempted only when BOTH owner_email AND from_email are present. Conditions reference the Prep node because Google Sheets update output shape is not relied upon.

nodes.name: Skip Owner Email
nodes.notes: Clean skip when owner/from email config missing; booking state is already committed.

parameters.subject: ={{ 'Booking confirmed — ' + $('Prep Lead Booked Update').first().json.business_name + ' — Lead ' + $('Prep Lead Booked Update').first().json.lead_id }}

nodes.name: Owner Booking Notification
nodes.notes: FRESH native Email Send node (n8n-nodes-base.emailSend v2.1 — replaces obsolete n8n-nodes-base.sendEmail). Same SMTP credential proven in Lead Intake V4.3. n8n attribution footer disabled. onError isolates SMTP failure: booking stays committed either way.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'booked', lead_id: $('Prep Lead Booked Update').first().json.lead_id, booking_id: $('Prep Lead Booked Update').first().json.booking_id, code: 200 }) }}

nodes.name: Respond 200 Booked
nodes.notes: Terminal success response. Reads via node reference so it is identical whether the owner email succeeded or failed. Owner-email success AND error outputs both converge here.
